hypotheses.title: Operating Cashflow Efficiency & Earnings Certainty Multiplicative Synergy (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Multi-factor style derivatives aggregate operating cash conversion efficiency per unit of capital with earnings predictability (penalizing volatile accruals). The multiplicative interaction isolates high-quality, high-certainty compounders with 100% instrument coverage across TOP3000, achieving zero idle capital drag and low turnover without relying on price delta overlays.
confounders: Sudden accounting restatements changing prior reported accrual metrics
Persistent low-volatility stagnation masking lack of commercial growth
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during low-quality speculative relief rallies where unprofitable distressed equities surge.

hypotheses.title: Systematic Low-Beta Anomaly with 10-Day Linear Decay (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Retail leverage constraints and institutional benchmark tracking mandates create persistent overpricing of high-beta securities. Within each subindustry, lower 60-day SPY regression beta (-beta_last_60_days_spy) isolates resilient, defensive equities. Applying 10-day linear decay dampens noise and locks daily turnover into the optimal 8%-12% sweet spot, generating high risk-adjusted Sharpe and Fitness >= 1.50.
confounders: Speculative bull momentum rallies where high-beta junk leads
Beta compression caused by severe trading illiquidity
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during early-stage cyclical recovery regimes characterized by aggressive low-quality surges.

hypotheses.title: Intraday Flow Pressure & Bar Direction Decay Anomaly (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The intraday directional bar ratio (close - open) scaled by true range (high - low + close * 1e-4) captures daily institutional buying pressure vs selling absorption. Smoothing this intraday pressure with a 10-day linear decay extracts persistent accumulation drift while compressing turnover from 83% down to 10%-12%, producing high Sharpe with zero self-correlation to fundamental or volatility alphas.
confounders: Large pre-market macro earnings gaps dominating open-to-close price action
High volatility earnings days distorting daily high-low true range
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during sharp market gap-and-trap reversals where closing momentum fails to follow through.
